profile.headline: Founding Software Engineer @ AchillesHR
profile.summary: Backend-leaning full stack software engineer with expertise in Python, TypeScript, AWS infrastructure (Terraform), and React. AWS-certified.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
- Spearheaded the ground-up development of a client-facing advertising reporting tool in Python and AWS, achieving 99%+ uptime across 80+ client marketing teams.
- Established comprehensive monitoring infrastructure using DataDog and OpenTelemetry, tracking 10+ key performance metrics and enabling zero-downtime deployments.
- Architected and launched autoscaling AWS infrastructure for a Slack-integrated chatbot leveraging RAG and the Confluence API to deliver real-time, context-aware answers to 10+ channel advertising teams, supporting dozens of
concurrent users while drastically improving support efficiency and response accuracy.
- Reduced client asset upload times by over 70% by leading a small engineering team in the object-oriented design and development of a scalable Python-based marketing automation tool used to interface with Google and Microsoft Ads APIs

positions.title: Software Engineer I
positions.description:
- Owned the research, growth, and development of a client-facing tool written in Python, currently installed across 80+ client marketing teams and used over 200 times per month.
- Built a net-new context-aware generative ad copy tool using Vertex AI and Python, allowing client advertising teams to automatically respond to market and trend changes with zero latency.
- Developed several highly-requested features on the Django backend API for a social marketing tool responsible for generating over 30% greater return on ad spend for onboarded client teams and creating over $1 million in revenue. Contributed several bug fixes and features to the React frontend of this tool.
positions.insights: Amazon Web Services (AWS), Python (Programming Language) and +2 skills

positions.title: Program Management and Operations Support Intern
positions.description:
- Owned the development of a net-new internal Python utility designed to sync Active Directory data to an internally-hosted GitLab instance ensuring all 50+ organization users had the appropriate repository access, deployed on-premises with Docker and Linux.
- Configured and maintained a network of 15+ Ubuntu systems used as a testbed for the Liberty Eclipse project, a cybersecurity training program run by the Department of Energy. Remotely managed and monitored this network using Ansible, Grafana, and Loki to ensure 100% network uptime.
- Automated secure reset processes for 100+ pieces of critical networking equipment by developing a custom PXE boot server with Raspberry Pi and nwipe.

positions.title: Information Technology Team Lead
positions.description:
- Collaborated with 9+ other student-managers to coordinate the work of over 45 student consultants.
- Conducted interviews for prospective employees and provided decision recommendations to hiring manager.
- Trained up to 4 new-hire student consultants per week on Help Desk policy, procedure, and tools.

positions.title: Information Technology Help Desk
positions.description:
- Resolved 1000+ technical issues for University of Illinois affiliates over the phone, via email, and in person.
- Ensured proper working condition of over 300 technology-enhanced classrooms across University of Illinois campus through weekly routine maintenance.
- Utilized staff training resources to work in a conscientious manner with sensitive information, such as personal contacts and protected health information.

projects.title: Data Storytelling Toolkit for Librarians
projects.description:
Led by Prinicipal Investigators Drs. Kate McDowell and Matt Turk, the Data Storytelling Toolkit for Librarians aims to help public libraries communicate their value by mapping data they already collect to common data stories. 

My responsibilities while working on this project included:
- cleaning messy datasets using industry-standard techniques in Python.
- discovering the potential of new visualization and storytelling solutions, such as Vega-lite and Grafana.
- exploring new data storytelling techniques to communicate library data in an easy-to-understand format.
